== Summary ==
At the world premiere of ''The Fellowship of the Ring'' in London (2001). The magazine's caption reads: "At the premiere: (left to right) Anthony and Elizabeth Vittone, Gabrielle Gerard, Warren Holland, Tomi Inkinen, and Sarah Bradley." That is [[Anthony Vittone]] at left and Decipher CEO [[Warren Holland]] fourth from left. Inkinen and Bradley won the Fan Club premiere sweepstakes. Photo: Decipher.

== Source ==
* Tomi M. Inkinen, "Journey of a Lifetime: The World Premiere of ''The Lord of the Rings''", ''The Lord of the Rings Fan Club Official Movie Magazine'' 2 (April/May 2002), Decipher, p. 11. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/lotr-fan-club-official-movie-magazine-issue-02-gandalf-300-dpi/page/n10/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n10). The Internet Archive item is itself the preserved copy.
* Cropped from the page scan to the photograph only (box 854,0 to 2171,1194 of the 2325×3135 leaf).
* Identification: the printed caption (above) names everyone, left to right.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced photograph from a page of a Decipher-published magazine, used only to identify Anthony Vittone and Warren Holland on their articles on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the magazine or harm its market.
